description: fluent-2-inspired's raised shadow at 1.1.5, an 8px ambient layer at 16% and a 0 32px 64px key at 36% of the shadow role, on platform-neutral, which every registry holds. CI run 41510373684 found OA's captions at 4.00:1 beside it, 32px below a raised object, where the key lays half its alpha, so the gate reads the key layer and composites it beside the object (B, 2026-11-02).

tokens.shadow-raised: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 16%, transparent), 0 32px 64px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 36%, transparent)
